scope: Desktop/web dashboard, asset detail, wallet account, send, receive, transaction, token, NFT, message signing and Coinjoin page wrappers plus principal composed dialogs. Source inspection only; no runtime or tests executed.

findings: Inspected both experiment variants: classic portfolio/assets and asset-first Home. Existing nodes already distinguish graph, layout, grouping, small balances, NFTs, offers and discovery retry.

Market price/range, account selection, identifiers/copy, history and explorer are already represented. Contextual Earn/Sign & Verify/WalletConnect actions link to their existing target capabilities rather than duplicate nodes.
Global hidden asset listing/unhide are represented; this wrapper is distinct from per-account hidden Tokens route.

Checked populated, empty, direct-RPC older-history and Coinjoin branches. Found search-filtered export missing as a distinct intent. Suspicious transaction filter is already present; there is no independent direction filter in this composition.
Type/path, xpub, nonce, Coinjoin rescan and BIP329 controls represented. Coinjoin log-folder control is debug-mode-only and excluded from ordinary user features.
Network-dispatched options and outputs covered by existing send leaves; automatic account/token draft restoration was missing and is proposed.
Fresh/history addresses, copy, verification-after-copy, QR, labeling, browser-dependent sharing, network guidance and device locks represented.
Successful-result Clear operation is distinct from send-form Clear and was missing. Inspected failure editing, success locking, format/public-key selection and copy actions.

Registered normal/hidden/inactive/DeFi branches and Stellar manual-entry modal inspected. Classic-token trustline deactivation and local contract-token watch removal are different outcomes; the latter was missing. Soroban manual contract-ID input and calldata already have existing map descriptions, so no duplicate nodes added.
Normal/hidden collections, recognition grouping, search, identifier, history and explorer are mapped. Non-NFT networks redirect to account overview.

Syncing versus loaded states and recommended/custom settings, anonymity, fee cap, skipping rounds, private balance and start/stop/resume already mapped. Source presence is conditional, not proof a coordinator is currently available.
Separate authorization/consent wrapper remains mapped to existing Coinjoin confirmation.
Global account/asset selection and network filtering are represented by global Send.
Asset/account tabs, search/network filter, account creation and network setup represented. Retry control reuses wallet discovery intent.
Enable, selected total, select all, sorting, search, private/nonprivate/dust grouping already mapped. Per-UTXO detail and labels navigate to existing transaction-detail/labeling capabilities.
Preset/custom Bitcoin/EVM/Tron controls and recommended reset represented; low-fee warnings belong to fee-selection validation.
Review, device signing, signed raw-copy/download, countdown and outcome state belong to existing review nodes. Recovery button is noted as a variant rather than a separately reachable feature.
New price-change intent distinguished from simply displaying historical fiat amount.
Existing data node explicitly includes Stellar contract calls; decoded function, argument and authorized-call rows refine that existing scope.
Account retry/enable branches reuse existing discovery/network-activation outcomes. Missing account/loading screens are states rather than new capabilities.

Coinjoin coordinator availability was not evaluated; source controls may be gated by flags/backend readiness.
